scope: Proposition 5.2 (Formal trace comparison) of the manuscript “A marked tensor obstruction to four-dimensional disk embedding” (preprints/A-marked-tensor-obstruction-to-four-dimensional-disk-embedding-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 305 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6453a6d9ab0cf566), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be a finite triangulated space, and let aX ∈ ( AX ⊗ ĝ ⊗mR )1 , (dX + Q)aX + 1 2[aX, aX] = 0, represent a family of local systems formally near the trivial one. For its evaluation map evaX : XB × Spf R → BG, the image of ev∗ aX ωκ under the Betti coefficient map of [14, §2.1] is the class of ΘX = 1 2κ(δRaX, δRaX), (dX + LQ)ΘX = 0, δRΘX = 0, (5.3) in the full complex Cl2 R(AX). This identification is natural for source restrictions, derived coefficient changes, and integration of source cochains. For an oriented compact three-manifold Z with boundary S, it also identifies the relative- orientation isotropic homotopy with integration of ΘZ over Z. If S = S2 and the sphere condition is represented by aS = νb, where ν is a two-form and b has internal degree −1, then ΘS = 0 strictly. Using the zero isotropic path on this sphere model, the resulting intersection form is represented by 1 2 ∫ Z κ(δRaZ, δRaZ) as a closed two-form of degree −1.
